create_llvm_env: create an LlvmEnv instance to interact with the LLVM compiler optimization environment
make_benchmark_from_source: create an LLVM benchmark from C or C++ source files using make_benchmark
make_benchmark_from_command_line: create an LLVM benchmark from a gcc or clang command line invocation
write_ir_to_file: write the current LLVM IR of the program state to a text file
write_bitcode_to_file: write the current program state as an LLVM bitcode file to disk
